metadata.title: Secure‑SDLC Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan establishing Secure‑SDLC as the authoritative framework for software delivery without granting deployment or execution authority.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits the Secure‑SDLC composite pattern, including the SDLC Core and all SDLC solution patterns.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure‑SDLC Platform governs how software delivery artifacts are created, assured, protected, and handed to operations. It enforces strict non‑equivalence between SDLC completion and runtime deployment or execution.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Authoritative plane for software delivery artifacts only.

props.name: sdlc-scope
props.remarks: Secure‑SDLC applies only before runtime execution.

props.name: non-equivalence
props.remarks: SDLC outputs are necessary but insufficient for deployment or execution.

props.name: implicit-authority
props.remarks: Build success, signatures, provenance, or assurance must not imply deploy or execute permission.

props.name: automation-boundary
props.remarks: Automation must not infer deployment authority from SDLC outcomes.

props.name: domain-override
props.remarks: Secure‑Device and Secure‑Resilience SSPPs override Secure‑SDLC outcomes.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure‑SDLC Platform is implemented through governance, eligibility signaling, and strict boundary enforcement. It does not perform builds, tests, deployments, or runtime actions.

roles.title: SDLC Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines Secure‑SDLC semantics, scope, and non‑equivalence rules.

roles.title: SDLC Governance
roles.remarks: Approves SDLC policies and acceptable reliance boundaries.

roles.title: SDLC Operations
roles.remarks: Operates software delivery pipelines within Secure‑SDLC constraints.

roles.title: SDLC Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors violations of SDLC trust boundaries and unsafe reliance attempts.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through Secure‑SDLC interpretation of NIST SP 800‑53 control families SA, CM, IA, AU, SI, and SR. This SSPP introduces no new control requirements and does not authorize deployment or execution.
